purpose: Top-down Early Modern Armory, Modern Arms Factory, Modern land Oil Well and Modern deep-water Oil Rig

artifacts.subject: Early Modern ARMORY, a compact organized workshop producing early firearms. Square pale cobbled courtyard, a main northern red-brick and limestone workshop footprint with a detailed blue-grey SLATE HIP ROOF, two tiny chimney-mouth TOPS and small roof skylights. A smaller rectangular slate store roof on west, a long pale canvas assembly-shelter ROOF patch to east. Two exposed courtyard workbench TOPS visibly hold orderly brown wood musket stocks and slim iron musket barrel shapes, as small recognizable art props without technical diagrams or close-up mechanics. An overhead rack of a few finished long wood-and-dark-metal MUSKETS lies flat, small wooden weapon shipping-crate TOPS and iron bar bundles near southern loading gate. One restrained orange-glowing forge TOP visible in an open yard work area, anvil top and tiny barrel circles, little charcoal bin. No swords, bows, cannons, statues, factory chimneys standing upright or modern trucks. Low enclosure appears as thin stone wall TOP strips around site with bottom entry gap. Warm stone, slate, red brick, aged oak, dark wrought iron and restrained forge orange. Production workshop rather than just storage; emphasis remains building roofs and readable firearm workbench props. No front-facing crossed-gun signs, facades or text.
artifacts.prompt:
Create ONE standalone top-down strategy-game building/resource icon on a genuine transparent background, matching the approved Age of Fronts building art in the attached reference. The reference supplies ONLY the hand-painted realistic materials, finely detailed roof textures, color balance, and strict overhead camera. Do not copy its subject, floorplan, prop layout or building type.

CAMERA AND GEOMETRY: exact vertical nadir orthographic roof-plan view, camera perpendicular to ground/deck. All circular horizontal objects are perfect circles. Pitched roofs have centered ridges and equally wide slopes; roofs entirely hide facades, doors and windows. Buildings show only their roof and rooftop details. Fences show thin plan lines with tiny post tops. Machinery is seen only from its TOP; elevated structures rise toward the viewer, not toward the top edge of the image. No vertical wall bands under roofs, no side-view towers, no foreshortened ground. All four compass edges are equally viewed from above. No isometric or oblique miniature, no frontal cutaway. Dimensional feel comes from roof slope shading, surface textures and very short subtle contact shadows.

MATERIALS / FRAMING: finely textured realistic hand-painted game illustration, rich weathered stone/wood/slate/brick/metal as appropriate, crisp silhouette, muted natural colors, restrained top-left light and tiny down-right shadows, matching the existing icon set. Square canvas. One complete bounded site occupies roughly 80-84 percent of canvas width/height with generous transparent margin on every side. Preserve all props and water/foliage within margins. True transparent alpha outside the site; no solid background, black fill, fake checkerboard, UI, text labels, decorative frame or watermark. No people. Single icon, never a multi-panel sheet.

artifacts.subject: Modern ARMS FACTORY producing firearms, a compact high-tech industrial compound on square grey concrete and asphalt ground. Large northern corrugated steel production-hall ROOF footprint with several long narrow skylights and two tiny rooftop HVAC square TOPS; flat-roof quality-control/office footprint at north-east. Small long corrugated storage ROOF west. Middle open courtyard has two orderly covered outdoor inspection bench TOPS with a few tiny dark firearm silhouettes laid flat horizontally, simple parts trays and neat olive-green shipping-crate TOP stacks; stylized object props, no engineering diagram or close-up mechanism. A modest fenced loading area at southern edge, white parking/loading lines and yellow caution strips, two small olive delivery-van TOPS and one freight loading trailer TOP, finished weapon-crate pallets along east, little blue utility crate accents. A very small service annex grey roof at bottom-left. Entire site strict overhead; vehicles only roof/bonnet tops. Secure thin metal fence plan line with tiny square post TOPS, lower entry gap and small red-white barrier plan. Weathered pale grey metal, dark olive crates, muted navy accents, concrete, yellow ground paint. Make the firearm production identity visible in courtyard art props while roofs dominate. No giant cooling towers, oil tanks, cannons, missiles, explosions, people, legible signs or words.

artifacts.subject: Modern LAND OIL WELL: compact onshore single pumpjack extraction site on a small irregular sandy-grey gravel and concrete pad. ONE weathered dark olive / gunmetal beam pumpjack in the center, represented strictly by its horizontal equipment TOP plan: elongated walking-beam top spine, short crossbeam tops, narrow crank-link tops, small motor housing TOP and tiny circular wellhead TOP directly below its rounded beam end. It must be a view of the horizontal tops of the pump assembly, never the familiar upright side-profile horsehead silhouette. One perfectly circular small silver storage-tank ROOF disc at north-east, one tiny grey corrugated control/maintenance cabin ROOF at north-west. Yellow-painted pipe TOP lines run between circular wellhead, small separator skid TOP rectangle and storage tank. A few metal barrel circles and a small olive utility cabinet at lower edge, tiny yellow caution paint patches, short service driveway plan entering bottom, low fence plan line around part of footprint. Sparse brown stones and little scrub plant canopy patches at outer edge. Modest readable extraction site, not an expansive refinery or mine shaft. No huge factory, visible tank cylinder sidewalls, standing drilling derrick, upright pump silhouette or smoke. Natural dry rocky land and industrial gray/olive/yellow accents. Remain legible after downsampling to 627 x 627 without shrinking the icon footprint within the canvas.

artifacts.subject: Modern DEEP-WATER OIL RIG, a compact floating semi-submersible offshore drilling platform viewed exactly vertically above, isolated within a small bounded dark navy/teal ocean-water patch. Broad rectangular grey steel deck TOP plan with a central square dark drill-well opening and square steel derrick lattice TOP footprint over it; narrow symmetrical top beams and tiny sheave TOP circles, no upright derrick side silhouette. White-grey corrugated and flat accommodation/operations ROOF modules along west/north deck edge, small rooftop vent squares. Yellow safety walkway plan lines and yellow handrail TOP lines around deck and drill area. One round raised helipad TOP disc at north-west or left edge, perfect circular yellow ring and a single white H; no helicopter. Parallel dark drill-pipe TOP racks at east, one horizontal service-crane jib TOP over southern deck and small crate TOPs. Two narrow orange enclosed lifeboat ROOF silhouettes at outer right/lower deck edge. Four small broad column/pontoon TOP footprints at deck corners, with water surrounding them; no support legs down to seabed, no jack-up leg elevation, no shore or attached land. Detailed blue-grey deck, yellow safety accents, white cabin roofs, dark steel, orange rescue craft, dark deep-water ripples only within a compact uneven water silhouette. Entire site should occupy about 82 percent of canvas and true transparent alpha outside the narrow water patch. No oil spill, fire, giant tanker, coastal harbour, many containers, upright tower panorama, side hulls, lettering other than one helipad H. Readable as one floating deep-water platform when downsampled to 627 x 627.
